$comment: Label-on-fill contrast matrix (#3896): every filled CMP-001 Button role, plus the selected fill of a pressed toggle (CMP-002 aria-pressed=true, CMP-003 selected segment), the label token it binds, and the fill token of each interaction state that exists as a token.

Checked in every theme by packages/ui/test/contrast/label-on-fill.test.ts (the CI gate, unit-frontend; labels also in every chart colour mode) and by packages/ui/tokens/tests/verify_tokens.py (the token proof).

A label clears `label` (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3) on every state fill. A role's states are pairwise at least `stateLightness` apart in CIE L*, and where `hue` is set each state is within `stateHue` degrees of LCh hue of the rest fill. Where `distinctFrom` is set, the role's rest fill is at least `stateLightness` L* from each listed fill, so a pressed toggle never looks like a primary button.

Where `boundary` is set, the rest fill clears `boundary` (SC 1.4.11) against every surface in `surfaces`. Where `outline` is set instead, the role draws a 2 px inner outline in that token, and the outline carries the boundary: it clears `boundary` against every surface and against each of the role's fills. Hover and pressed fills are not held to the boundary: SC 1.4.11 does not require a hover or pressed indicator to contrast with the rest state, and under a white label no three dark primary states 5 L* apart fit the band that clears both 4.5:1 and 3:1.

Disabled with reason (`disabledWithReason.gated`, the E05-D02 gated state): only the fill, outline or track dims to `opacity`; the label renders at full opacity in `label` and the locked glyph in `glyph`. Each role's rest fill is composited at that opacity over every surface in `surfaces`, and on the result the label clears `label` and the glyph clears `glyph`. The reason tooltip text clears `label` on its surface (`text`); a ghost control has no fill, so its glyph clears `glyph` on each surface (`glyph`).
Plain `disabled` (no reason) dims the whole control, label included, to `opacity.disabled`. It is an inactive control, which SC 1.4.3 exempts, so it is not checked.

Focus ring (`focusRing`): `ring` clears `boundary` against every surface in `focusRing.surfaces` in every theme (SC 1.4.11; with its 2 px offset the ring's adjacent colour is the surface). In each theme of `distinctThemes` it is also at least `ringDeltaE` (CIE76) from each fill in `distinctFrom`, so on a focused primary or selected control the ring never reads as part of the fill.

A state with no token (danger hover and active, buy and sell active, secondary active) is owner decision A2 of the E05-D02 component spec (#161, PR #3914); once its token lands it must be added here, and the gate fails on any `<role>.<stateSuffix>` token missing from this list.
